foundations.purpose: Lean 4.33.1 logical and datatype foundations; kernel checks proof terms.
Extensional predicate sets, membership, subset, images and set algebra.
Ordinary/generalized syntax, occurrence predicates and blank-node transports, including generated eliminators and equality decisions.
Subtype domains, partial assignments, restriction and denotation agreement proofs.
Truth-preservation composition and explicit witness/countermodel constructions.
Transport along blank-node functions and disjoint-union assignments.
Engineering contract for finite enumerations: exact set membership plus no duplicate occurrences. Not a W3C claim that every graph is finite.
Small formal counterexample exhibiting the informative shared-witness issue.
Draft structural range and record-reference certificate implementing COV-01/02/03; not a semantic completeness proof.
Checked countermodel to an unrestricted generalized-graph reading; source scope remains an explicit expert-review question, not an asserted erratum.
Simultaneous term substitution, resource-valued pullbacks and inverse renaming on occurring blanks; generated helpers inherit these obligations.
Canonical interpretation, assignment decoding and ordinary interpolation, including generated helpers.
Finite image enumeration and compactness through interpolation.
Syntactic name occurrence including the explicit literal datatype projection.
Name preservation by substitution and nonexpansion under simple entailment.
Scoped freshness, inverse-name retraction and conservativity over the existing substitution and entailment definitions.
Model existence, process truth preservation and composition under semantic extensions.
A single RDF property condition, its rule consequence and conditional generalized substitution theorem; not a complete RDF interpretation.
Bridge typed IEXT, ambient relation notation and triple denotations.
Fixed datatype theory, partial value realization, D-conditions and model-class proofs; concrete datatype meanings remain external.
Symbolic RDF vocabulary, complete infinite axiom family, RDF-condition conjunction and its consequences.
Shared fresh witness for rdfD1 and inherited datatype inconsistency.
RDFS vocabulary, axiom families, class-extension definitions and semantic conditions in one shared universe.
RDFS rule instances, compositional truth/entailment soundness and derived disjoint-datatype inconsistency.
Construct explicit D-models, characterize satisfiability, and exhibit a conditional entailment-direction counterexample.
Recognized literal values and simultaneous value-preserving graph substitution.
Source-exact generalized axiom seeds, inductive closure and positive-check soundness; completeness remains open.
Derive generic membership from indexed membership through full RDFS axioms and named rules.
Ordinary dataset syntax, equivalence with unique-name pairs, global occurrence support and presence-sensitive representation equality.
Global blank bijections preserving default and named graphs, with induced component graph isomorphisms and equivalence.
Checked witnesses for loss of cross-graph sharing and loss of empty-named-graph presence under quad projection.
Explicit candidate dataset regimes, adopted content conditions, model restrictions and conditional graph-consequence transfer.
A fixed-IRI presence policy retains default content and isomorphism invariance while changing dataset entailment.
Two explicit simple-model witnesses with true component graphs and an example graph-object embedding; RDF/RDFS and engine guidance remain separate.
Illustrative fixed-name graph comparisons with empty fallback, and a checked distinction from structural dataset isomorphism.

Explicit full-domain RDF model construction, reuse of D-model literals, sufficient parameter assumptions and countermodels for non-type ground assertions. These choices do not redefine the RDF model class.

Necessary compatibility consequences from the existing RDF/RDFS conditions: actual language-literal representatives and transfer of unsatisfiability through model inclusion. Not a model-existence assumption.

Explicit RDFS witness family over the existing RDF model, full condition and axiom proofs, language-literal coverage equivalence for base D, and source-facing countermodels. Constructor choices do not redefine RDFS interpretations.

Ordinary reification/container example syntax, shared free-property calculations, RDFS countermodels and a positive entailment isolating an existential-scope source question. Informative uses do not add model axioms.

Natural-number injections exclude finite certified enumerations. Applications distinguish full name-mapping graphs, ordinary RDF triple sets and chosen RDFS member extensions. Conditional witness parameters, concrete name correspondence and general extension/expressivity gaps remain explicit.

Ordinary collection-description shapes; domain/range and nil typing via existing rules; shared-assignment countermodels for permutation, branching, missing rest and derived nil self-edges. Arbitrary unrecognized item IRIs and explicit constructor hypotheses retain the source scopes.

Exact Skolem consequence lifting using separate source/conclusion blank copies, a naming-map extension, simple-interpretation transfer and fixed predicate occurrence. Includes the distinction from ambient-total naming and compiler-generated reduction helpers.

Finite occurring blank support, finite injection/surjection, proper substitution composition and the exact self-instance obstruction for lean-graph non-entailment. Includes a derived infinite ordinary proper self-instance explicitly proved non-lean, plus compiler-generated support.

Derived additional class/property typing families, recognition-scoped datatype typing, shared rule-composition helpers and universal class/resource consequences. Includes an empty-class model witness using the refined unnamed column while preserving the existing semantic conditions.

Explicit name-domain maps, simple-interpretation restriction/completion, truth with shared blank assignments, satisfiability and entailment locality, and finite comparison vocabulary. Does not establish a finite-resource bound or datatype/RDF/RDFS completion.

Induced active-domain restriction, exact finite support enumeration, N+B+1 simple countermodels and bounded-preinterpretation entailment/satisfiability equivalences. Supports shared blank identities, partial IL and property referents outside IR; does not certify D/RDF/RDFS compression or executable search.

Localized fixed datatype conditions and supported restriction; N+B+1 weakened countermodels, bounded satisfiability equivalence, and the checked empty-comparison printed-bound conflict under nonempty IR. Does not certify datatype entailment completion or the printed multiplicative bound.

Injective completion of fixed values and full-name D-interpretations; embedded-assignment truth and ordinary graph satisfaction; ordinary vocabulary restriction and bounded entailment equivalence; a finite abstract generalized-scope obstruction with nonempty datatype spaces and a satisfiable full premise. Does not establish generalized comparison preservation or concrete datatype/name correspondence.

Additional ordinary-graph admission and fixed simple-model conditions; exact simple/D/RDF/RDFS regime connections; actual syntax/model refinement; legal-but-unsatisfiable and deletion/admission boundaries; an enriched-model reduct with proved truth correspondence. Does not classify all richer languages or prove cross-edition or executable compatibility.

A rule-closed syntactic invariant for the printed Appendix A E-only container-axiom selection, separate full RDFS entailment and consistency, and an inhabited datatype interface with lexical/tag predicates explicit. Supports a source-review question, not an official erratum, repaired completeness theorem, concrete IRI/XSD/BCP47 implementation or package refinement.

Finite supporting terms, cubic generalized-triple bounds and exact finiteness of the unchanged Appendix A procedure. Includes a consistent infinite-premise witness and finite empty-input closures omitting full-vocabulary tautologies. These support qualified results and source-review questions, not runtime complexity, corrected completeness, official errata or implementation refinement.

Exact executable refinement of the unchanged finite-input Appendix A RDF/RDFS closure. Certified decoder, axiom seed, rule rounds and sufficient finite saturation imply duplicate-free exact membership and graph-invariant counts. Does not establish source completeness, concrete parsing, polynomial cost or package refinement.

Project-owned symbolic runtime fixtures for the executable closure contract. Their decoder proof is kernel checked; Boolean checks are separately executed and are not W3C tests, native-evaluation proofs or npm verification.

Exact finite simultaneous instance-subgraph search, certified witnesses, ordinary simple-entailment decisions, independent blank-domain transport and selected-closure composition. Includes explicit generalized-positive and selected-closure-negative scope witnesses. No runtime complexity, full RDF/RDFS completeness, concrete parser or package refinement claim.

Project-owned symbolic execution regressions for instance search and closure composition. Runtime checks supplement universal kernel proofs and are distinct from W3C fixtures, native-evaluation proof shortcuts and npm verification.

Arbitrary set-sized indexed and set-of-graph unions/merges, coherent assignments, exact projection, common-domain instance and disjoint-support isomorphism. Includes empty/infinite families, reindexing and certified size examples. Historical RDF 2004 correspondence and concrete source identity/allocation are not proved.

Appendix A ordinary no-fallback seed and finite sound graph transitions; explicit fresh rdfD1 policy; all-axiom ordinary-conclusion invariant and printed RDFS example; shared-literal generalized instance; distinct printed intermediate review question. Not an ordinary saturation evaluator or a blanket rejection of certified witness reuse.

Structured RDF 1.1 literal components and raw identity; full imported RFC 5646 ABNF well-formedness and ASCII case handling; actual language-value representatives; conditional D-equivalence under normalization and deduplicated finite images. Does not establish a general executable tag recognizer, registry validity, concrete IRI/XSD correspondence, an RDF 1.2 bridge or package refinement.

declarations.name: RDF11.Enumeration.mk.noConfusion
declarations.type:

declarations.name: RDF11.Enumeration.unique.eq_2
declarations.type:

  RDF11.Enumeration.unique (t :: ts) =
    if t ∈ RDF11.Enumeration.unique ts then RDF11.Enumeration.unique ts else t :: RDF11.Enumeration.unique ts

      have rest := RDF11.Enumeration.unique ts;
      if t ∈ rest then rest else t :: rest

declarations.type: true = false ∨ true = true

declarations.name: RDF11.GeneralizedScope.I._proof_3
declarations.type: false = false ∨ false = true

declarations.name: RDF11.GeneralizedScope.I.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal : Type} [inst : DecidableEq Iri] (p : Iri),
  RDF11.GeneralizedScope.I p =
    { IR := fun x => x = false, IR_nonempty := RDF11.GeneralizedScope.I._proof_1, IP := fun x => x = true,

      IS := fun i =>

      IL := fun x => none }

declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal : Type} {U : Type u_1} {Blank : Type} (I : RDF11.SimpleInterpretation Iri Literal U)
  (A : I.Assignment Blank) (t : RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal Blank),
  I.TripleTrue A t =
    ∃ p s o,
      I.denote A t.predicate = some p.val ∧

  (IL : Literal → Option { x // IR x }) (IR_1 : RDF11.Set U) (IR_nonempty_1 : ∃ x, IR_1 x) (IP_1 : RDF11.Set U)

declarations.name: RDF11.DatatypeModel.literal.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal Value : Type} (T : RDF11.DatatypeTheory Iri Literal Value) (D : RDF11.Set Iri) (l : Literal),
  RDF11.DatatypeModel.literal T D l =
    if D (T.literalSyntax.datatype l) then
      match T.literalSyntax.language l with
      | some tag =>
        some (RDF11.DatatypeModel.embed (T.languageValue (T.literalSyntax.lexical l) (RDF11.asciiLower tag)))
      | none =>
        Option.map RDF11.DatatypeModel.embed
          (T.L2V (T.identified (T.literalSyntax.datatype l)) (T.literalSyntax.lexical l))
    else some RDF11.DatatypeModel.unnamed

      T.literalSyntax.datatype l = a →

  (∀ (tag : String) (a_1 : D T.literalSyntax.langString) (a_2 : T.literalSyntax.language a = some tag),
      motive (T.languageValue (T.literalSyntax.lexical a) (RDF11.asciiLower tag)) ⋯) →
    (∀ (a_1 : Iri) (v : Value) (a_2 : D a_1) (a_3 : a_1 ≠ T.literalSyntax.langString)
        (a_4 : T.literalSyntax.datatype a = a_1) (a_5 : T.L2V (T.identified a_1) (T.literalSyntax.lexical a) = some v),
        motive v ⋯) →
      ∀ {a_1 : Value} (t : T.RecognizedValue D a a_1), motive a_1 t

declarations.type:

  RDF11.RDFModelConstruction.interpretation T D v R =
    { IR := fun x => True, IR_nonempty := ⋯, IP := fun x => True,
      IEXT := fun p xy =>
        if p.val = RDF11.RDFModelConstruction.name (v.iri RDF11.RDFSymbol.rdfType) then
          RDF11.RDFModelConstruction.typeExtension T xy.fst.val xy.snd.val
        else R p.val xy.fst.val xy.snd.val,
      IS := fun a => ⟨RDF11.RDFModelConstruction.iriValue T D a, ⋯⟩,
      IL := fun l =>
        Option.map (fun r => ⟨RDF11.RDFModelConstruction.lift r.val, True.intro⟩)
          ((RDF11.DatatypeModel.interpretation T D).IL l) }

declarations.name: RDF11.RDFSModelConstruction.relation.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal Value : Type} (T : RDF11.DatatypeTheory Iri Literal Value) (v : RDF11.RDFSVocabulary Iri)
  (Q :
    RDF11.RDFModelConstruction.Carrier Iri Value →
      RDF11.RDFModelConstruction.Carrier Iri Value → RDF11.RDFModelConstruction.Carrier Iri Value → Prop)
  (p x y : RDF11.RDFModelConstruction.Carrier Iri Value),
  RDF11.RDFSModelConstruction.relation T v Q p x y =
    if p = RDF11.RDFSModelConstruction.schemaName v (RDF11.RDFSSymbol.rdf RDF11.RDFSymbol.rdfType) then
      RDF11.RDFModelConstruction.typeExtension T x y
    else
      if p = RDF11.RDFSModelConstruction.schemaName v RDF11.RDFSSymbol.subClassOf then
        RDF11.RDFSModelConstruction.subclass T x y
      else
        if p = RDF11.RDFSModelConstruction.schemaName v RDF11.RDFSSymbol.subPropertyOf then
          RDF11.RDFSModelConstruction.subproperty v x y
        else
          if
              p = RDF11.RDFSModelConstruction.schemaName v RDF11.RDFSSymbol.domain ∨
                p = RDF11.RDFSModelConstruction.schemaName v RDF11.RDFSSymbol.range then
            RDF11.RDFSModelConstruction.NameObject y
          else
            if
                p = RDF11.RDFSModelConstruction.schemaName v RDF11.RDFSSymbol.member ∨
                  p = RDF11.RDFSModelConstruction.schemaName v RDF11.RDFSSymbol.seeAlso then
              True
            else Q p x y

    ∀ (c m : RDF11.RDFSSymbol),
      RDF11.RDFSModelConstruction.SchemaSymbol c →
        RDF11.RDFSModelConstruction.SchemaSymbol m →
          m ≠ c →
            have premise := fun origin =>
              RDF11.Set.ofList
                [{ subject := RDF11.Subject.iri (v.iri c),
                    predicate := v.iri (RDF11.RDFSSymbol.rdf RDF11.RDFSymbol.rdfType),
                    object := RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri (RDF11.RDFSSymbol.rdf RDF11.RDFSymbol.rdfBag)) },

                  { subject := RDF11.Subject.iri (v.iri origin),
                    predicate := v.iri (RDF11.RDFSSymbol.rdf RDF11.RDFSymbol.rdfValue),
                    object := RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri RDF11.RDFSSymbol.resource) }];
            have claim := fun destination =>
              RDF11.Set.singleton
                { subject := RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri destination),

                  object := RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri RDF11.RDFSSymbol.resource) };

              ¬RDF11.RDFSEntails T D v (premise m).generalize (claim c)

        RDF11.RDFSModelConstruction.SchemaSymbol o →
          RDF11.RDFSModelConstruction.FreeProperty p →
            ((RDF11.RDFSModelConstruction.interpretation T D v Q).TripleTrue A

                  object := RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri o) } ↔

declarations.type:

              r₂ ≠ r₁ →
                have t := RDF11.ReificationExamples.valueTriple v s o;
                have G :=
                  RDF11.Set.union (t.reification v.toRDF (RDF11.Subject.iri (v.iri r₁)))

declarations.type:

  (v : RDF11.RDFSVocabulary Iri),
  RDF11.RDFSModelConstruction.Parameters T D v →
    ∃ U I,
      I.RDFSModel T D v ∧
        I.Satisfies (RDF11.ContainerInfinitude.allIndexed v).generalize ∧
          ∃ root member,
            I.ICEXT (v.iri (RDF11.RDFSSymbol.rdf RDF11.RDFSymbol.rdfType))
                (I.IS (v.iri (RDF11.RDFSSymbol.rdf RDF11.RDFSymbol.rdfBag))).val root ∧
              (∀ (n : Nat), member n = (I.IS (v.iri (RDF11.RDFSSymbol.rdf (RDF11.RDFSymbol.container n)))).val) ∧
                (∀ (m n : Nat), member m = member n → m = n) ∧
                  ∀ (n : Nat),
                    I.Relates (I.IS (v.iri (RDF11.RDFSSymbol.rdf (RDF11.RDFSymbol.container n)))).val root (member n) ∧
                      I.Relates (I.IS (v.iri RDF11.RDFSSymbol.member)).val root (member n)

declarations.name: RDF11.RDFSModelConstruction.free_term_triple_iff
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal Value B : Type} (T : RDF11.DatatypeTheory Iri Literal Value) (D : RDF11.Set Iri)
  (v : RDF11.RDFSVocabulary Iri),
  RDF11.RDFSModelConstruction.Parameters T D v →
    ∀
      (Q :
        RDF11.RDFModelConstruction.Carrier Iri Value →
          RDF11.RDFModelConstruction.Carrier Iri Value → RDF11.RDFModelConstruction.Carrier Iri Value → Prop)
      (A : (RDF11.RDFSModelConstruction.interpretation T D v Q).Assignment B) (s o : RDF11.Term Iri Literal B)
      (p : RDF11.RDFSSymbol),
      RDF11.RDFSModelConstruction.SchemaSymbol p →
        RDF11.RDFSModelConstruction.FreeProperty p →
          ((RDF11.RDFSModelConstruction.interpretation T D v Q).TripleTrue A
              { subject := s, predicate := RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri p), object := o } ↔
            ∃ x y,
              (RDF11.RDFSModelConstruction.interpretation T D v Q).denote A s = some x ∧
                (RDF11.RDFSModelConstruction.interpretation T D v Q).denote A o = some y ∧
                  Q (RDF11.RDFSModelConstruction.schemaName v p) x y)

declarations.name: RDF11.RDFSModelConstruction.free_unrecognized_object_triple_iff
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal Value B : Type} (T : RDF11.DatatypeTheory Iri Literal Value) (D : RDF11.Set Iri)
  (v : RDF11.RDFSVocabulary Iri),
  RDF11.RDFSModelConstruction.Parameters T D v →
    ∀
      (Q :
        RDF11.RDFModelConstruction.Carrier Iri Value →
          RDF11.RDFModelConstruction.Carrier Iri Value → RDF11.RDFModelConstruction.Carrier Iri Value → Prop)
      (A : (RDF11.RDFSModelConstruction.interpretation T D v Q).Assignment B) (s : RDF11.Term Iri Literal B)
      (p : RDF11.RDFSSymbol),
      RDF11.RDFSModelConstruction.SchemaSymbol p →
        RDF11.RDFSModelConstruction.FreeProperty p →
          ∀ (a : Iri),
            ¬D a →
              ((RDF11.RDFSModelConstruction.interpretation T D v Q).TripleTrue A
                  { subject := s, predicate := RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri p), object := RDF11.Term.iri a } ↔
                ∃ x,
                  (RDF11.RDFSModelConstruction.interpretation T D v Q).denote A s = some x ∧
                    Q (RDF11.RDFSModelConstruction.schemaName v p) x (RDF11.RDFModelConstruction.name a))

declarations.name: RDF11.Herbrand.interpretation.eq_1
declarations.type:

  RDF11.Herbrand.interpretation G =
    { IR := fun x => True, IR_nonempty := ⋯, IP := fun x => True,
      IEXT := fun p pair =>
        ∃ t,
          G t ∧
            p.val = RDF11.Herbrand.encode t.predicate ∧
              pair.fst.val = RDF11.Herbrand.encode t.subject ∧ pair.snd.val = RDF11.Herbrand.encode t.object,
      IS := fun i => ⟨RDF11.Herbrand.encode (RDF11.Term.iri i), ⋯⟩,
      IL := fun l => some ⟨RDF11.Herbrand.encode (RDF11.Term.literal l), True.intro⟩ }

  (sk : RDF11.Skolemization datatype G) (I : RDF11.SimpleInterpretation Iri Literal U) (A : I.Assignment B),
  sk.namedInterpretation I A =
    { IR := I.IR, IR_nonempty := ⋯, IP := I.IP, IEXT := I.IEXT,
      IS := fun i =>

declarations.name: RDF11.PreInterpretation.extend._proof_2
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal : Type} {U : Type u_1} {V : RDF11.Set (RDF11.Name Iri Literal)} (I : RDF11.PreInterpretation V U),
  I.IR (Classical.choose ⋯) ∨ I.IP (Classical.choose ⋯)

declarations.name: RDF11.PreInterpretation.extend.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal : Type} {U : Type u_1} {V : RDF11.Set (RDF11.Name Iri Literal)} (I : RDF11.PreInterpretation V U),
  I.extend =
    { IR := I.IR, IR_nonempty := ⋯, IP := I.IP, IEXT := I.IEXT,
      IS := fun i => if h : V (Sum.inl i) then I.IS ⟨i, h⟩ else ⟨Classical.choose ⋯, ⋯⟩,
      IL := fun l => if h : V (Sum.inr l) then I.IL ⟨l, h⟩ else none }

declarations.name: RDF11.FiniteDatatypeModel.compress
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal Value B : Type} {U : Type u} {V : RDF11.Set (RDF11.Name Iri Literal)} {S : RDF11.Set B}
  (I : RDF11.SimpleInterpretation Iri Literal U) (T : RDF11.DatatypeTheory Iri Literal Value) (D : RDF11.Set Iri)
  (ρ : RDF11.ValueRealization Value U),
  I.DConditions T D ρ →
    ∀ (v : RDF11.Enumeration V) (b : RDF11.Enumeration S) (G : RDF11.GeneralizedGraph Iri Literal B)
      (hV : (RDF11.GeneralizedGraph.vocabulary T.literalSyntax.datatype G).subset V),
      RDF11.Set.subset G.hasBlank S →
        I.Satisfies G →
          ∃ P,
            RDF11.SimpleInterpretation.BoundedDomain P (v.triples.length + b.triples.length + 1) ∧
              P.DConditions T D ρ ∧
                RDF11.SimpleInterpretation.Satisfies P
                    (RDF11.GeneralizedGraph.restrictNames T.literalSyntax.datatype V G hV) ∧
                  ∀ (C : Type) (E : RDF11.GeneralizedGraph Iri Literal C)
                    (hE : (RDF11.GeneralizedGraph.vocabulary T.literalSyntax.datatype E).subset V),
                    RDF11.SimpleInterpretation.Satisfies P
                        (RDF11.GeneralizedGraph.restrictNames T.literalSyntax.datatype V E hE) →
                      I.Satisfies E

    (RDF11.DSatisfiable T D G ↔
      ∃ U P,

declarations.type:

  (G E : RDF11.GeneralizedGraph Iri Literal B),
  RDF11.FiniteGraph G →
    RDF11.FiniteGraph E →
      ¬RDF11.DEntails T D G E →
        let V :=

  RDF11.DatatypeCompletion.interpretation P T D ρ =
    { IR := fun x => True, IR_nonempty := ⋯, IP := fun x => True,

  (T : RDF11.DatatypeTheory Iri Literal Value) (D : RDF11.Set Iri) (ρ : RDF11.ValueRealization Value U) (l : Literal),
  RDF11.DatatypeCompletion.literalValue P T D ρ l =
    if D (T.literalSyntax.datatype l) then
      if T.literalSyntax.datatype l = T.literalSyntax.langString then
        Option.map (fun tag => ρ.embed (T.languageValue (T.literalSyntax.lexical l) (RDF11.asciiLower tag)))
          (T.literalSyntax.language l)
      else Option.map ρ.embed (T.L2V (T.identified (T.literalSyntax.datatype l)) (T.literalSyntax.lexical l))
    else if hl : V (Sum.inr l) then Option.map (fun r => Sum.inl r.val) (P.IL ⟨l, hl⟩) else none

  (lower_valid : ∀ (tag : String), validTag tag → validTag (RDF11.asciiLower tag)) (x : String),
  (if
        Sum.inl
              {
                  langString :=
                    RDF11.ClosureSelection.vocabulary.iri (RDF11.RDFSSymbol.rdf RDF11.RDFSymbol.rdfLangString),
                  lexical := fun l =>
                    match l with
                    | RDF11.ClosureSelection.WitnessLiteral.typed s datatype => s
                    | RDF11.ClosureSelection.WitnessLiteral.tagged s tag => s,
                  datatype := fun l =>
                    match l with
                    | RDF11.ClosureSelection.WitnessLiteral.typed lexical a => a.val
                    | RDF11.ClosureSelection.WitnessLiteral.tagged lexical tag =>
                      RDF11.ClosureSelection.vocabulary.iri (RDF11.RDFSSymbol.rdf RDF11.RDFSymbol.rdfLangString),
                  language := fun l =>
                    match l with
                    | RDF11.ClosureSelection.WitnessLiteral.typed lexical datatype => none
                    | RDF11.ClosureSelection.WitnessLiteral.tagged lexical tag => some tag.val,
                  languageTag := validTag, tag_valid := ⋯, lower_valid := lower_valid, tagged_iff := ⋯ }.langString =
            Sum.inl (RDF11.ClosureSelection.vocabulary.iri (RDF11.RDFSSymbol.rdf RDF11.RDFSymbol.xsdString)) ∧
          stringLexical x = true then

∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} (xs : List α) (f : α → List β) (n : Nat),
  (∀ (x : α), x ∈ xs → (f x).length = n) → (List.flatMap f xs).length = xs.length * n

declarations.name: RDF11.ClosureBound.mem_cube
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal B : Type} (xs : List (RDF11.Term Iri Literal B)) (t : RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B),
  t ∈ RDF11.ClosureBound.cube xs ↔ RDF11.ClosureBound.OnTerms (RDF11.Set.ofList xs) t

declarations.name: RDF11.ClosureBound.mem_cube._simp_1_2
declarations.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {f : α → List β} {b : β} {l : List α}, (b ∈ List.flatMap f l) = ∃ a, a ∈ l ∧ b ∈ f a

declarations.name: RDF11.ClosureBound.mem_cube._simp_1_3
declarations.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {b : β} {f : α → β} {l : List α}, (b ∈ List.map f l) = ∃ a, a ∈ l ∧ f a = b

declarations.name: RDF11.ClosureBound.mem_expanded
declarations.type:
∀ {Literal Iri B : Type} (datatype : Literal → Iri) (t : RDF11.Term Iri Literal B),
  t ∈ RDF11.ClosureBound.expanded datatype t

declarations.name: RDF11.ClosureBound.pool_fixed
declarations.type:
∀ {Literal Iri B : Type} {a : Iri} (datatype : Literal → Iri) (fixed : List Iri)
  (triples : List (RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B)),
  a ∈ fixed → RDF11.Term.iri a ∈ RDF11.ClosureBound.termPool datatype fixed triples

declarations.name: RDF11.ClosureBound.pool_literal
declarations.type:
∀ {Literal Iri B : Type} {l : Literal} (datatype : Literal → Iri) (fixed : List Iri)
  (triples : List (RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B)),
  RDF11.Term.literal l ∈ RDF11.ClosureBound.termPool datatype fixed triples →
    RDF11.Term.iri (datatype l) ∈ RDF11.ClosureBound.termPool datatype fixed triples

declarations.name: RDF11.ClosureBound.pool_literal._simp_1_2
declarations.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {a : α} {s t : List α}, (a ∈ s ++ t) = (a ∈ s ∨ a ∈ t)

declarations.name: RDF11.ClosureBound.pool_literal._simp_1_3
declarations.type: ∀ {a b c : Prop}, ((a ∨ b) ∨ c) = (a ∨ b ∨ c)

declarations.name: RDF11.ClosureBound.pool_triple
declarations.type:
∀ {Literal Iri B : Type} {t : RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B} (datatype : Literal → Iri) (fixed : List Iri)
  (triples : List (RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B)),
  t ∈ triples → RDF11.ClosureBound.OnTerms (RDF11.Set.ofList (RDF11.ClosureBound.termPool datatype fixed triples)) t

declarations.name: RDF11.ClosureBound.pool_triple._simp_1_2
declarations.type:
∀ {Literal Iri B : Type} (datatype : Literal → Iri) (t : RDF11.Term Iri Literal B),
  (t ∈ RDF11.ClosureBound.expanded datatype t) = True

declarations.name: RDF11.ClosureBound.range_symbols_fixed
declarations.type:
∀ (x : RDF11.RDFSSymbol × RDF11.RDFSSymbol),
  x ∈ RDF11.rdfsRangeAxioms → x.fst ∈ RDF11.ClosureBound.rdfsFixedSymbols ∧ x.snd ∈ RDF11.ClosureBound.rdfsFixedSymbols

declarations.name: RDF11.ClosureBound.rdfFixedSymbols
declarations.type: List RDF11.RDFSymbol

declarations.name: RDF11.ClosureBound.rdfFixedSymbols.eq_1
declarations.type:
RDF11.ClosureBound.rdfFixedSymbols =
  [RDF11.RDFSymbol.rdfType, RDF11.RDFSymbol.rdfProperty, RDF11.RDFSymbol.rdfSubject, RDF11.RDFSymbol.rdfPredicate,
    RDF11.RDFSymbol.rdfObject, RDF11.RDFSymbol.rdfFirst, RDF11.RDFSymbol.rdfRest, RDF11.RDFSymbol.rdfValue,
    RDF11.RDFSymbol.rdfNil, RDF11.RDFSymbol.rdfList, RDF11.RDFSymbol.rdfLangString, RDF11.RDFSymbol.xsdString,
    RDF11.RDFSymbol.rdfStatement, RDF11.RDFSymbol.rdfAlt, RDF11.RDFSymbol.rdfBag, RDF11.RDFSymbol.rdfSeq]

declarations.name: RDF11.ClosureBound.rdfNames
declarations.type: {Iri : Type} → RDF11.RDFVocabulary Iri → List Nat → List Iri

declarations.name: RDF11.ClosureBound.rdfNames.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri : Type} (v : RDF11.RDFVocabulary Iri) (indices : List Nat),
  RDF11.ClosureBound.rdfNames v indices =
    List.map v.iri RDF11.ClosureBound.rdfFixedSymbols ++
      List.map (fun n => v.iri (RDF11.RDFSymbol.container n)) (0 :: indices)

declarations.name: RDF11.ClosureBound.rdfTerms
declarations.type:
{Iri Literal Value B : Type} →
  RDF11.DatatypeTheory Iri Literal Value →
    RDF11.RDFVocabulary Iri → List (RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B) → List Nat → List (RDF11.Term Iri Literal B)

declarations.name: RDF11.ClosureBound.rdfTerms.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal Value B : Type} (T : RDF11.DatatypeTheory Iri Literal Value) (v : RDF11.RDFVocabulary Iri)
  (triples : List (RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B)) (indices : List Nat),
  RDF11.ClosureBound.rdfTerms T v triples indices =
    RDF11.ClosureBound.termPool T.literalSyntax.datatype (RDF11.ClosureBound.rdfNames v indices) triples

declarations.name: RDF11.ClosureBound.rdf_axiom_container_unique
declarations.type:
∀ {Literal Iri B : Type} (datatype : Literal → Iri) (v : RDF11.RDFVocabulary Iri)
  (t : RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B),
  v.axioms t →
    ∀ (m n : Nat),
      RDF11.GeneralizedTriple.names datatype t (Sum.inl (v.iri (RDF11.RDFSymbol.container m))) →
        RDF11.GeneralizedTriple.names datatype t (Sum.inl (v.iri (RDF11.RDFSymbol.container n))) → m = n

declarations.name: RDF11.ClosureBound.rdf_axiom_container_unique._simp_1_1
declarations.type: ∀ {Iri : Type} (v : RDF11.RDFVocabulary Iri) (a b : RDF11.RDFSymbol), (v.iri a = v.iri b) = (a = b)

declarations.name: RDF11.ClosureBound.rdf_axioms_onTerms
declarations.type:
∀ {Literal Iri B : Type} (datatype : Literal → Iri) (v : RDF11.RDFVocabulary Iri)
  (V : RDF11.Set (RDF11.Term Iri Literal B)),
  (∀ (s : RDF11.RDFSymbol), s ∈ RDF11.ClosureBound.rdfFixedSymbols → V (RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri s))) →
    ∀ (t : RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B),
      v.axioms t →
        (∀ (n : Nat),
            RDF11.GeneralizedTriple.names datatype t (Sum.inl (v.iri (RDF11.RDFSymbol.container n))) →
              V (RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri (RDF11.RDFSymbol.container n)))) →
          RDF11.ClosureBound.OnTerms V t

declarations.name: RDF11.ClosureBound.rdf_closure_bound
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal Value B₁ B₂ : Type} (T : RDF11.DatatypeTheory Iri Literal Value) (v : RDF11.RDFVocabulary Iri)
  (G : RDF11.GeneralizedGraph Iri Literal B₁) (E : RDF11.GeneralizedGraph Iri Literal B₂) (g : RDF11.Enumeration G)
  (indices : List Nat),
  (∀ (n : Nat),
      RDF11.GeneralizedGraph.vocabulary T.literalSyntax.datatype E (Sum.inl (v.iri (RDF11.RDFSymbol.container n))) →
        n ∈ indices) →
    ∃ terms closure, closure.triples.length ≤ terms.triples.length ^ 3

declarations.name: RDF11.ClosureBound.rdf_closure_contains
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal Value B₁ B₂ : Type} (T : RDF11.DatatypeTheory Iri Literal Value) (v : RDF11.RDFVocabulary Iri)
  (G : RDF11.GeneralizedGraph Iri Literal B₁) (E : RDF11.GeneralizedGraph Iri Literal B₂),
  RDF11.Set.subset G (RDF11.RDFClosure T v G E)

declarations.name: RDF11.ClosureBound.rdf_closure_finite
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal Value B₁ B₂ : Type} (T : RDF11.DatatypeTheory Iri Literal Value) (v : RDF11.RDFVocabulary Iri)
  (G : RDF11.GeneralizedGraph Iri Literal B₁) (E : RDF11.GeneralizedGraph Iri Literal B₂),
  RDF11.FiniteGraph G → RDF11.FiniteGraph E → RDF11.FiniteGraph (RDF11.RDFClosure T v G E)

declarations.name: RDF11.ClosureBound.rdf_closure_finite_iff
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal Value B₁ B₂ : Type} (T : RDF11.DatatypeTheory Iri Literal Value) (v : RDF11.RDFVocabulary Iri)
  (G : RDF11.GeneralizedGraph Iri Literal B₁) (E : RDF11.GeneralizedGraph Iri Literal B₂),
  RDF11.FiniteGraph (RDF11.RDFClosure T v G E) ↔
    RDF11.FiniteGraph G ∧
      Nonempty
        (RDF11.Enumeration fun n =>
          RDF11.GeneralizedGraph.vocabulary T.literalSyntax.datatype E (Sum.inl (v.iri (RDF11.RDFSymbol.container n))))

declarations.name: RDF11.ClosureBound.rdf_closure_finite_selected
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal Value B₁ B₂ : Type} (T : RDF11.DatatypeTheory Iri Literal Value) (v : RDF11.RDFVocabulary Iri)
  (G : RDF11.GeneralizedGraph Iri Literal B₁) (E : RDF11.GeneralizedGraph Iri Literal B₂),
  RDF11.FiniteGraph G →
    Nonempty
        (RDF11.Enumeration fun n =>
          RDF11.GeneralizedGraph.vocabulary T.literalSyntax.datatype E
            (Sum.inl (v.iri (RDF11.RDFSymbol.container n)))) →
      RDF11.FiniteGraph (RDF11.RDFClosure T v G E)

declarations.name: RDF11.ClosureBound.rdf_closure_onTerms
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal Value B₁ B₂ : Type} (T : RDF11.DatatypeTheory Iri Literal Value) (v : RDF11.RDFVocabulary Iri)
  (G : RDF11.GeneralizedGraph Iri Literal B₁) (E : RDF11.GeneralizedGraph Iri Literal B₂) (g : RDF11.Enumeration G)
  (indices : List Nat),
  (∀ (n : Nat),
      RDF11.GeneralizedGraph.vocabulary T.literalSyntax.datatype E (Sum.inl (v.iri (RDF11.RDFSymbol.container n))) →
        n ∈ indices) →
    RDF11.Set.subset (RDF11.RDFClosure T v G E)
      (RDF11.ClosureBound.OnTerms (RDF11.Set.ofList (RDF11.ClosureBound.rdfTerms T v g.triples indices)))

declarations.name: RDF11.ClosureBound.rdf_container_in_pool
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal Value B : Type} (T : RDF11.DatatypeTheory Iri Literal Value) (v : RDF11.RDFVocabulary Iri)
  (triples : List (RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B)) (indices : List Nat) (n : Nat),
  n ∈ 0 :: indices →
    RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri (RDF11.RDFSymbol.container n)) ∈ RDF11.ClosureBound.rdfTerms T v triples indices

declarations.name: RDF11.ClosureBound.rdf_empty_closure_indexed_absent
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal Value B : Type} (T : RDF11.DatatypeTheory Iri Literal Value) (v : RDF11.RDFVocabulary Iri) (n : Nat),
  n ≠ 0 → ¬RDF11.RDFClosure T v RDF11.Set.empty RDF11.Set.empty (RDF11.ClosureBound.indexedPropertyAxiom v n)

declarations.name: RDF11.ClosureBound.rdf_empty_closure_indexed_absent._simp_1_6
declarations.type: ∀ {Iri : Type} (v : RDF11.RDFVocabulary Iri) (a b : RDF11.RDFSymbol), (v.iri a = v.iri b) = (a = b)

declarations.name: RDF11.ClosureBound.rdf_empty_closure_omits_tautology
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal Value B : Type} (T : RDF11.DatatypeTheory Iri Literal Value) (v : RDF11.RDFVocabulary Iri),
  have G := RDF11.Set.empty;
  ∃ n,
    ¬RDF11.RDFClosure T v G G (RDF11.ClosureBound.indexedPropertyAxiom v n) ∧
      RDF11.RDFEntails T v.baseDatatypes v G (RDF11.Set.singleton (RDF11.ClosureBound.indexedPropertyAxiom v n))

declarations.name: RDF11.ClosureBound.rdf_finite_premise_of_finite_closure
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal Value B₁ B₂ : Type} (T : RDF11.DatatypeTheory Iri Literal Value) (v : RDF11.RDFVocabulary Iri)
  (G : RDF11.GeneralizedGraph Iri Literal B₁) (E : RDF11.GeneralizedGraph Iri Literal B₂),
  RDF11.FiniteGraph (RDF11.RDFClosure T v G E) → RDF11.FiniteGraph G

declarations.name: RDF11.ClosureBound.rdf_fixed_in_pool
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal Value B : Type} (T : RDF11.DatatypeTheory Iri Literal Value) (v : RDF11.RDFVocabulary Iri)
  (triples : List (RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B)) (indices : List Nat) (s : RDF11.RDFSymbol),
  s ∈ RDF11.ClosureBound.rdfFixedSymbols → RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri s) ∈ RDF11.ClosureBound.rdfTerms T v triples indices

declarations.name: RDF11.ClosureBound.rdf_fixed_or_container
declarations.type: ∀ (s : RDF11.RDFSymbol), s ∈ RDF11.ClosureBound.rdfFixedSymbols ∨ ∃ n, s = RDF11.RDFSymbol.container n

declarations.name: RDF11.ClosureBound.rdf_iri_eq
declarations.type: ∀ {Iri : Type} (v : RDF11.RDFVocabulary Iri) (a b : RDF11.RDFSymbol), v.iri a = v.iri b ↔ a = b

declarations.name: RDF11.ClosureBound.rdf_seed_onTerms
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal Value B₁ B₂ : Type} (T : RDF11.DatatypeTheory Iri Literal Value) (v : RDF11.RDFVocabulary Iri)
  (G : RDF11.GeneralizedGraph Iri Literal B₁) (E : RDF11.GeneralizedGraph Iri Literal B₂) (g : RDF11.Enumeration G)
  (indices : List Nat),
  (∀ (n : Nat),
      RDF11.GeneralizedGraph.vocabulary T.literalSyntax.datatype E (Sum.inl (v.iri (RDF11.RDFSymbol.container n))) →
        n ∈ indices) →
    RDF11.Set.subset
      (RDF11.AxiomSeed T.literalSyntax.datatype (fun n => v.iri (RDF11.RDFSymbol.container n)) v.axioms G E)
      (RDF11.ClosureBound.OnTerms (RDF11.Set.ofList (RDF11.ClosureBound.rdfTerms T v g.triples indices)))

declarations.name: RDF11.ClosureBound.rdf_selected_typing
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal Value B₁ B₂ : Type} (T : RDF11.DatatypeTheory Iri Literal Value) (v : RDF11.RDFVocabulary Iri)
  (G : RDF11.GeneralizedGraph Iri Literal B₁) (E : RDF11.GeneralizedGraph Iri Literal B₂) (n : Nat),
  RDF11.GeneralizedGraph.vocabulary T.literalSyntax.datatype E (Sum.inl (v.iri (RDF11.RDFSymbol.container n))) →
    RDF11.RDFClosure T v G E (RDF11.ClosureBound.indexedPropertyAxiom v n)

declarations.name: RDF11.ClosureBound.rdf_step_onTerms
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal Value B : Type} {t : RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B} (T : RDF11.DatatypeTheory Iri Literal Value)
  (D : RDF11.Set Iri) (v : RDF11.RDFVocabulary Iri) (V : RDF11.Set (RDF11.Term Iri Literal B)),
  V (RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri RDF11.RDFSymbol.rdfType)) →
    V (RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri RDF11.RDFSymbol.rdfProperty)) →
      (∀ (l : Literal), V (RDF11.Term.literal l) → V (RDF11.Term.iri (T.literalSyntax.datatype l))) →
        ∀ (H : RDF11.GeneralizedGraph Iri Literal B),
          RDF11.Set.subset H (RDF11.ClosureBound.OnTerms V) → RDF11.RDFStep T D v H t → RDF11.ClosureBound.OnTerms V t

declarations.type: List RDF11.RDFSSymbol

declarations.type:
RDF11.ClosureBound.rdfsFixedSymbols =

    [RDF11.RDFSSymbol.domain, RDF11.RDFSSymbol.range, RDF11.RDFSSymbol.resource, RDF11.RDFSSymbol.literal,
      RDF11.RDFSSymbol.datatype, RDF11.RDFSSymbol.class_, RDF11.RDFSSymbol.subClassOf, RDF11.RDFSSymbol.subPropertyOf,
      RDF11.RDFSSymbol.member, RDF11.RDFSSymbol.container, RDF11.RDFSSymbol.containerMembershipProperty,

declarations.name: RDF11.ClosureBound.rdfsNames
declarations.type: {Iri : Type} → RDF11.RDFSVocabulary Iri → List Nat → List Iri

declarations.name: RDF11.ClosureBound.rdfsNames.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri : Type} (v : RDF11.RDFSVocabulary Iri) (indices : List Nat),

    List.map v.iri RDF11.ClosureBound.rdfsFixedSymbols ++

declarations.name: RDF11.ClosureBound.rdfsRuleNames
declarations.type: {Iri : Type} → RDF11.RDFSVocabulary Iri → List Iri

declarations.name: RDF11.ClosureBound.rdfsRuleNames.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri : Type} (v : RDF11.RDFSVocabulary Iri),
  RDF11.ClosureBound.rdfsRuleNames v =
    List.map v.iri
      [RDF11.RDFSSymbol.rdf RDF11.RDFSymbol.rdfType, RDF11.RDFSSymbol.resource, RDF11.RDFSSymbol.datatype,
        RDF11.RDFSSymbol.subPropertyOf, RDF11.RDFSSymbol.subClassOf, RDF11.RDFSSymbol.member, RDF11.RDFSSymbol.literal]

declarations.name: RDF11.ClosureBound.rdfsTerms
declarations.type:
{Iri Literal Value B : Type} →
  RDF11.DatatypeTheory Iri Literal Value →
    RDF11.RDFSVocabulary Iri → List (RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B) → List Nat → List (RDF11.Term Iri Literal B)

declarations.name: RDF11.ClosureBound.rdfsTerms.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal Value B : Type} (T : RDF11.DatatypeTheory Iri Literal Value) (v : RDF11.RDFSVocabulary Iri)
  (triples : List (RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B)) (indices : List Nat),
  RDF11.ClosureBound.rdfsTerms T v triples indices =
    RDF11.ClosureBound.termPool T.literalSyntax.datatype (RDF11.ClosureBound.rdfsNames v indices) triples

declarations.name: RDF11.ClosureBound.rdfs_axiom_container_unique
declarations.type:
∀ {Literal Iri B : Type} (datatype : Literal → Iri) (v : RDF11.RDFSVocabulary Iri)
  (t : RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B),
  v.axioms t →
    ∀ (m n : Nat),
      RDF11.GeneralizedTriple.names datatype t (Sum.inl (v.iri (RDF11.RDFSSymbol.rdf (RDF11.RDFSymbol.container m)))) →
        RDF11.GeneralizedTriple.names datatype t
            (Sum.inl (v.iri (RDF11.RDFSSymbol.rdf (RDF11.RDFSymbol.container n)))) →
          m = n

declarations.name: RDF11.ClosureBound.rdfs_axiom_container_unique._proof_1_3
declarations.type: ∀ (m n k : Nat), m = k → n = k → ¬m = n → False

declarations.name: RDF11.ClosureBound.rdfs_axiom_container_unique._simp_1_2
declarations.type: ∀ {Iri : Type} (v : RDF11.RDFSVocabulary Iri) (a b : RDF11.RDFSSymbol), (v.iri a = v.iri b) = (a = b)

declarations.name: RDF11.ClosureBound.rdfs_axioms_onTerms
declarations.type:
∀ {Literal Iri B : Type} (datatype : Literal → Iri) (v : RDF11.RDFSVocabulary Iri)
  (V : RDF11.Set (RDF11.Term Iri Literal B)),
  (∀ (s : RDF11.RDFSSymbol), s ∈ RDF11.ClosureBound.rdfsFixedSymbols → V (RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri s))) →
    ∀ (t : RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B),
      v.axioms t →
        (∀ (n : Nat),
            RDF11.GeneralizedTriple.names datatype t
                (Sum.inl (v.iri (RDF11.RDFSSymbol.rdf (RDF11.RDFSymbol.container n)))) →
              V (RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri (RDF11.RDFSSymbol.rdf (RDF11.RDFSymbol.container n))))) →
          RDF11.ClosureBound.OnTerms V t

declarations.name: RDF11.ClosureBound.rdfs_closure_bound
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal Value B₁ B₂ : Type} (T : RDF11.DatatypeTheory Iri Literal Value) (v : RDF11.RDFSVocabulary Iri)
  (G : RDF11.GeneralizedGraph Iri Literal B₁) (E : RDF11.GeneralizedGraph Iri Literal B₂) (g : RDF11.Enumeration G)
  (indices : List Nat),
  (∀ (n : Nat),
      RDF11.GeneralizedGraph.vocabulary T.literalSyntax.datatype E
          (Sum.inl (v.iri (RDF11.RDFSSymbol.rdf (RDF11.RDFSymbol.container n)))) →
        n ∈ indices) →
    ∃ terms closure, closure.triples.length ≤ terms.triples.length ^ 3

declarations.name: RDF11.ClosureBound.rdfs_closure_contains
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal Value B₁ B₂ : Type} (T : RDF11.DatatypeTheory Iri Literal Value) (v : RDF11.RDFSVocabulary Iri)
  (G : RDF11.GeneralizedGraph Iri Literal B₁) (E : RDF11.GeneralizedGraph Iri Literal B₂),
  RDF11.Set.subset G (RDF11.RDFSClosure T v G E)

declarations.name: RDF11.ClosureBound.rdfs_closure_finite
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal Value B₁ B₂ : Type} (T : RDF11.DatatypeTheory Iri Literal Value) (v : RDF11.RDFSVocabulary Iri)
  (G : RDF11.GeneralizedGraph Iri Literal B₁) (E : RDF11.GeneralizedGraph Iri Literal B₂),
  RDF11.FiniteGraph G → RDF11.FiniteGraph E → RDF11.FiniteGraph (RDF11.RDFSClosure T v G E)

declarations.name: RDF11.ClosureBound.rdfs_closure_finite_iff
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal Value B₁ B₂ : Type} (T : RDF11.DatatypeTheory Iri Literal Value) (v : RDF11.RDFSVocabulary Iri)
  (G : RDF11.GeneralizedGraph Iri Literal B₁) (E : RDF11.GeneralizedGraph Iri Literal B₂),
  RDF11.FiniteGraph (RDF11.RDFSClosure T v G E) ↔
    RDF11.FiniteGraph G ∧
      Nonempty
        (RDF11.Enumeration fun n =>

declarations.name: RDF11.AxiomSeed.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ {Literal Iri B₁ B₂ : Type} (datatype : Literal → Iri) (container : Nat → Iri)
  (axioms G : RDF11.GeneralizedGraph Iri Literal B₁) (E : RDF11.GeneralizedGraph Iri Literal B₂)
  (t : RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B₁),
  RDF11.AxiomSeed datatype container axioms G E t =
    (G t ∨
      RDF11.NonContainerAxioms datatype container axioms t ∨
        RDF11.ConclusionAxioms datatype container axioms E t ∨
          RDF11.Set.subset (RDF11.ConclusionAxioms datatype container axioms E)
              (RDF11.Set.union G (RDF11.NonContainerAxioms datatype container axioms)) ∧
            RDF11.ContainerAxioms datatype container axioms 0 t)

declarations.type:

declarations.type:

declarations.name: RDF11.ClosureEvaluation.rdfsBinary.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal B : Type} [inst : DecidableEq Iri] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Literal] [inst_2 : DecidableEq B]
  (v : RDF11.RDFSVocabulary Iri) (t u : RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B),
  RDF11.ClosureEvaluation.rdfsBinary v t u =
    RDF11.ClosureEvaluation.emit
                (t.predicate = RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri RDF11.RDFSSymbol.domain) ∧ u.predicate = t.subject)
                { subject := u.subject,
                  predicate := RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri (RDF11.RDFSSymbol.rdf RDF11.RDFSymbol.rdfType)),
                  object := t.object } ++
              RDF11.ClosureEvaluation.emit
                (t.predicate = RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri RDF11.RDFSSymbol.range) ∧ u.predicate = t.subject)
                { subject := u.object,
                  predicate := RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri (RDF11.RDFSSymbol.rdf RDF11.RDFSymbol.rdfType)),
                  object := t.object } ++
            RDF11.ClosureEvaluation.emit
              (t.predicate = RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri RDF11.RDFSSymbol.subPropertyOf) ∧
                u.predicate = RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri RDF11.RDFSSymbol.subPropertyOf) ∧ t.object = u.subject)
              { subject := t.subject, predicate := RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri RDF11.RDFSSymbol.subPropertyOf),
                object := u.object } ++
          RDF11.ClosureEvaluation.emit
            (t.predicate = RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri RDF11.RDFSSymbol.subPropertyOf) ∧ u.predicate = t.subject)
            { subject := u.subject, predicate := t.object, object := u.object } ++
        RDF11.ClosureEvaluation.emit
          (t.predicate = RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri RDF11.RDFSSymbol.subClassOf) ∧
            u.predicate = RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri (RDF11.RDFSSymbol.rdf RDF11.RDFSymbol.rdfType)) ∧ u.object = t.subject)
          { subject := u.subject, predicate := RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri (RDF11.RDFSSymbol.rdf RDF11.RDFSymbol.rdfType)),
            object := t.object } ++
      RDF11.ClosureEvaluation.emit
        (t.predicate = RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri RDF11.RDFSSymbol.subClassOf) ∧
          u.predicate = RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri RDF11.RDFSSymbol.subClassOf) ∧ t.object = u.subject)
        { subject := t.subject, predicate := RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri RDF11.RDFSSymbol.subClassOf), object := u.object }

declarations.name: RDF11.ClosureEvaluation.rdfsFixed.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal B : Type} (v : RDF11.RDFSVocabulary Iri),
  RDF11.ClosureEvaluation.rdfsFixed v =
    RDF11.ClosureEvaluation.rdfFixed v.toRDF ++
          List.map
            (fun x =>
              match x with
              | (s, o) =>
                { subject := RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri s), predicate := RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri RDF11.RDFSSymbol.domain),
                  object := RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri o) })
            RDF11.rdfsDomainAxioms ++
        List.map
          (fun x =>
            match x with
            | (s, o) =>
              { subject := RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri s), predicate := RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri RDF11.RDFSSymbol.range),
                object := RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri o) })
          RDF11.rdfsRangeAxioms ++
      List.map
        (fun x =>
          match x with
          | (s, p, o) =>
            { subject := RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri s), predicate := RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri p),
              object := RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri o) })
        RDF11.rdfsHierarchyAxioms

declarations.name: RDF11.ClosureEvaluation.rdfsUnary.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal B : Type} [inst : DecidableEq Iri] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Literal] [inst_2 : DecidableEq B]
  (v : RDF11.RDFSVocabulary Iri) (t : RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B),
  RDF11.ClosureEvaluation.rdfsUnary v t =
    [{ subject := t.subject, predicate := RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri (RDF11.RDFSSymbol.rdf RDF11.RDFSymbol.rdfType)),
                  object := RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri RDF11.RDFSSymbol.resource) },
                { subject := t.object,
                  predicate := RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri (RDF11.RDFSSymbol.rdf RDF11.RDFSymbol.rdfType)),
                  object := RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri RDF11.RDFSSymbol.resource) }] ++
              RDF11.ClosureEvaluation.emit
                (t.predicate = RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri (RDF11.RDFSSymbol.rdf RDF11.RDFSymbol.rdfType)) ∧
                  t.object = RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri (RDF11.RDFSSymbol.rdf RDF11.RDFSymbol.rdfProperty)))
                { subject := t.subject, predicate := RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri RDF11.RDFSSymbol.subPropertyOf),
                  object := t.subject } ++
            RDF11.ClosureEvaluation.emit
              (t.predicate = RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri (RDF11.RDFSSymbol.rdf RDF11.RDFSymbol.rdfType)) ∧
                t.object = RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri RDF11.RDFSSymbol.class_))
              { subject := t.subject, predicate := RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri RDF11.RDFSSymbol.subClassOf),
                object := RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri RDF11.RDFSSymbol.resource) } ++
          RDF11.ClosureEvaluation.emit
            (t.predicate = RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri (RDF11.RDFSSymbol.rdf RDF11.RDFSymbol.rdfType)) ∧
              t.object = RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri RDF11.RDFSSymbol.class_))
            { subject := t.subject, predicate := RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri RDF11.RDFSSymbol.subClassOf),
              object := t.subject } ++
        RDF11.ClosureEvaluation.emit
          (t.predicate = RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri (RDF11.RDFSSymbol.rdf RDF11.RDFSymbol.rdfType)) ∧
            t.object = RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri RDF11.RDFSSymbol.containerMembershipProperty))
          { subject := t.subject, predicate := RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri RDF11.RDFSSymbol.subPropertyOf),
            object := RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri RDF11.RDFSSymbol.member) } ++
      RDF11.ClosureEvaluation.emit
        (t.predicate = RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri (RDF11.RDFSSymbol.rdf RDF11.RDFSymbol.rdfType)) ∧
          t.object = RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri RDF11.RDFSSymbol.datatype))
        { subject := t.subject, predicate := RDF11.Term.iri (v.iri RDF11.RDFSSymbol.subClassOf),

declarations.name: RDF11.FiniteSaturation.run.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : DecidableEq α] (next : List α → List α) (fuel : Nat),
  RDF11.FiniteSaturation.run next fuel =
    Nat.rec (motive := fun x => List α → List α) (fun xs => xs)
      (fun x previous xs =>
        if RDF11.FiniteSaturation.stable next xs = true then xs else previous (RDF11.FiniteSaturation.advance next xs))
      fuel

declarations.name: RDF11.FiniteSaturation.run_exact
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal B : Type} [inst : DecidableEq Iri] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Literal] [inst_2 : DecidableEq B]
  (step : RDF11.GeneralizedGraph Iri Literal B → RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B → Prop)
  (next : List (RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B) → List (RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B)),
  (∀ (xs : List (RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B)) (t : RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B),
      t ∈ next xs ↔ step (RDF11.Set.ofList xs) t) →
    (∀ (G H : RDF11.Set (RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B)),
        G.subset H → ∀ (t : RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B), step G t → step H t) →
      ∀ (carrier : List (RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B)),
        (∀ (xs : List (RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B)), xs ⊆ carrier → next xs ⊆ carrier) →
          ∀ (fuel : Nat) (seed : List (RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B)),
            seed.Nodup →
              seed ⊆ carrier →
                carrier.length ≤ seed.length + fuel →
                  RDF11.Set.ofList (RDF11.FiniteSaturation.run next fuel seed) =
                    RDF11.RuleDerives step (RDF11.Set.ofList seed)

    ∀ (fuel : Nat) (xs : List α),
      xs.Nodup → xs ⊆ carrier → (RDF11.FiniteSaturation.run next fuel xs).length ≤ carrier.length

    ∀ (fuel : Nat) (xs : List α),
      (∀ (a : α), a ∈ xs → P a) → ∀ (a : α), a ∈ RDF11.FiniteSaturation.run next fuel xs → P a

declarations.type:

    ∀ (fuel : Nat) (xs : List α),
      xs.Nodup →
        xs ⊆ carrier →
          carrier.length ≤ xs.length + fuel →
            RDF11.FiniteSaturation.stable next (RDF11.FiniteSaturation.run next fuel xs) = true

∀ {Iri Literal B : Type} {inst : DecidableEq Iri} [inst_1 : DecidableEq Iri] {inst_2 : DecidableEq Literal}
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq Literal] {inst_4 : DecidableEq B} [inst_5 : DecidableEq B]
  (G G_1 : List (RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B)),
  G = G_1 →
    ∀ (E E_1 : List (RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B)),
      E = E_1 →
        ∀ (μ μ_1 : RDF11.Substitution Iri Literal B),
          μ = μ_1 → RDF11.InstanceSearch.accepts G E μ = RDF11.InstanceSearch.accepts G_1 E_1 μ_1

declarations.name: RDF11.InstanceSearch.accepts.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal B : Type} [inst : DecidableEq Iri] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Literal] [inst_2 : DecidableEq B]
  (G E : List (RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B)) (μ : RDF11.Substitution Iri Literal B),
  RDF11.InstanceSearch.accepts G E μ = E.all fun t => decide (RDF11.GeneralizedTriple.substitute μ t ∈ G)

declarations.name: RDF11.InstanceSearch.accepts_iff
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal B : Type} [inst : DecidableEq Iri] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Literal] [inst_2 : DecidableEq B]
  (G E : List (RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B)) (μ : RDF11.Substitution Iri Literal B),
  RDF11.InstanceSearch.accepts G E μ = true ↔
    RDF11.Set.subset (RDF11.GeneralizedGraph.substitute μ (RDF11.Set.ofList E)) (RDF11.Set.ofList G)

declarations.name: RDF11.InstanceSearch.accepts_iff._simp_1_2
declarations.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {p : α → Bool} {l : List α}, (l.all p = true) = ∀ (x : α), x ∈ l → p x = true

declarations.name: RDF11.InstanceSearch.apartCheck

{Iri Literal B₁ B₂ : Type} →

    [DecidableEq Literal] →
      [DecidableEq B₁] →

declarations.name: RDF11.InstanceSearch.apartCheck.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal B₁ B₂ : Type} [inst : DecidableEq Iri] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Literal] [inst_2 : DecidableEq B₁]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq B₂] (G : List (RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B₁))
  (E : List (RDF11.Triple Iri Literal B₂)),
  RDF11.InstanceSearch.apartCheck G E =
    RDF11.InstanceSearch.ordinaryCheck (List.map (RDF11.GeneralizedTriple.mapBlank Sum.inl) G)
      (List.map (RDF11.Triple.mapBlank Sum.inr) E)

declarations.name: RDF11.InstanceSearch.apartCheck_iff
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal B₁ B₂ : Type} [inst : DecidableEq Iri] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Literal] [inst_2 : DecidableEq B₁]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq B₂] (G : List (RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B₁))
  (E : List (RDF11.Triple Iri Literal B₂)),
  RDF11.InstanceSearch.apartCheck G E = true ↔
    RDF11.SimplyEntails (RDF11.Set.ofList G) (RDF11.Graph.generalize (RDF11.Set.ofList E))

declarations.name: RDF11.InstanceSearch.assignments
declarations.type:
{Iri Literal B : Type} →
  [DecidableEq B] → List (RDF11.Term Iri Literal B) → List B → List (RDF11.Substitution Iri Literal B)

declarations.name: RDF11.InstanceSearch.assignments.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal B : Type} [inst : DecidableEq B] (pool : List (RDF11.Term Iri Literal B)) (bs : List B),
  RDF11.InstanceSearch.assignments pool bs =
    List.foldr (fun b previous => List.flatMap (fun μ => List.map (RDF11.InstanceSearch.update μ b) pool) previous)
      [fun x => none] bs

declarations.name: RDF11.InstanceSearch.assignments_cover
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal B : Type} [inst : DecidableEq B] (pool : List (RDF11.Term Iri Literal B)) (bs : List B)
  (μ : RDF11.Substitution Iri Literal B),
  (∀ (b : B), b ∈ bs → μ.resolve b ∈ pool) →
    ∃ ν, ν ∈ RDF11.InstanceSearch.assignments pool bs ∧ ∀ (b : B), b ∈ bs → ν.resolve b = μ.resolve b

declarations.name: RDF11.InstanceSearch.assignments_length
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal B : Type} [inst : DecidableEq B] (pool : List (RDF11.Term Iri Literal B)) (bs : List B),
  (RDF11.InstanceSearch.assignments pool bs).length = pool.length ^ bs.length

declarations.name: RDF11.InstanceSearch.blank_image_in_terms

  RDF11.Set.subset (RDF11.GeneralizedGraph.substitute μ (RDF11.Set.ofList E)) (RDF11.Set.ofList G) →
    ∀ (b : B), b ∈ RDF11.InstanceSearch.blanks E → μ.resolve b ∈ RDF11.InstanceSearch.terms G

declarations.name: RDF11.InstanceSearch.candidates_complete
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal B : Type} [inst : DecidableEq Iri] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Literal] [inst_2 : DecidableEq B]
  (G E : List (RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B)) (μ : RDF11.Substitution Iri Literal B),
  RDF11.Set.subset (RDF11.GeneralizedGraph.substitute μ (RDF11.Set.ofList E)) (RDF11.Set.ofList G) →

declarations.name: RDF11.InstanceSearch.candidates_length
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal B : Type} [inst : DecidableEq Iri] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Literal] [inst_2 : DecidableEq B]

declarations.name: RDF11.InstanceSearch.certificate_isSome
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal B : Type} [inst : DecidableEq Iri] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Literal] [inst_2 : DecidableEq B]

declarations.name: RDF11.InstanceSearch.check
declarations.type:
{Iri Literal B : Type} →
  [DecidableEq Iri] →

declarations.name: RDF11.InstanceSearch.check.congr_simp
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal B : Type} {inst : DecidableEq Iri} [inst_1 : DecidableEq Iri] {inst_2 : DecidableEq Literal}
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq Literal] {inst_4 : DecidableEq B} [inst_5 : DecidableEq B]
  (G G_1 : List (RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B)),
  G = G_1 →
    ∀ (E E_1 : List (RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B)),
      E = E_1 → RDF11.InstanceSearch.check G E = RDF11.InstanceSearch.check G_1 E_1

declarations.name: RDF11.InstanceSearch.check.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal B : Type} [inst : DecidableEq Iri] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Literal] [inst_2 : DecidableEq B]
  (G E : List (RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B)),
  RDF11.InstanceSearch.check G E = (RDF11.InstanceSearch.search G E).isSome

declarations.name: RDF11.InstanceSearch.check_ground
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal B : Type} [inst : DecidableEq Iri] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Literal] [inst_2 : DecidableEq B]
  (G E : List (RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B)),
  RDF11.GeneralizedGraph.ground (RDF11.Set.ofList E) → RDF11.InstanceSearch.check G E = E.all fun t => decide (t ∈ G)

declarations.name: RDF11.InstanceSearch.check_iff
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal B : Type} [inst : DecidableEq Iri] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Literal] [inst_2 : DecidableEq B]
  (G E : List (RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B)),
  RDF11.InstanceSearch.check G E = true ↔
    ∃ μ, RDF11.Set.subset (RDF11.GeneralizedGraph.substitute μ (RDF11.Set.ofList E)) (RDF11.Set.ofList G)

declarations.name: RDF11.InstanceSearch.check_iff._simp_1_3
declarations.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {xs : List α} {p : α → Bool}, ((List.find? p xs).isSome = true) = ∃ x, x ∈ xs ∧ p x = true

declarations.name: RDF11.InstanceSearch.check_respects_graphs
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal B : Type} [inst : DecidableEq Iri] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Literal] [inst_2 : DecidableEq B]
  (G H E F : List (RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B)),
  RDF11.Set.ofList G = RDF11.Set.ofList H →
    RDF11.Set.ofList E = RDF11.Set.ofList F → RDF11.InstanceSearch.check G E = RDF11.InstanceSearch.check H F

declarations.type:
{Iri Literal B : Type} →

declarations.name: RDF11.InstanceSearch.entailment_apart_iff
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal B₁ B₂ : Type} (G : RDF11.GeneralizedGraph Iri Literal B₁) (E : RDF11.GeneralizedGraph Iri Literal B₂),
  RDF11.SimplyEntails (RDF11.GeneralizedGraph.mapBlank Sum.inl G) (RDF11.GeneralizedGraph.mapBlank Sum.inr E) ↔
    RDF11.SimplyEntails G E

declarations.name: RDF11.InstanceSearch.generalize_list
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal B : Type} (E : List (RDF11.Triple Iri Literal B)),

declarations.name: RDF11.InstanceSearch.mapBlank_list
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal B₁ B₂ : Type} (G : List (RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B₁)) (f : B₁ → B₂),
  RDF11.Set.ofList (List.map (RDF11.GeneralizedTriple.mapBlank f) G) =
    RDF11.GeneralizedGraph.mapBlank f (RDF11.Set.ofList G)

declarations.name: RDF11.InstanceSearch.mem_blanks
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal B : Type} [inst : DecidableEq B] (E : List (RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B)) (b : B),
  b ∈ RDF11.InstanceSearch.blanks E ↔ RDF11.GeneralizedGraph.hasBlank (RDF11.Set.ofList E) b

declarations.name: RDF11.InstanceSearch.mem_blanks._simp_1_2
declarations.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {f : α → List β} {b : β} {l : List α}, (b ∈ List.flatMap f l) = ∃ a, a ∈ l ∧ b ∈ f a

declarations.name: RDF11.InstanceSearch.mem_blanks._simp_1_3
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal B : Type} (t : RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B) (b : B),
  (b ∈ t.blankList) = RDF11.GeneralizedTriple.hasBlank b t

declarations.name: RDF11.InstanceSearch.mem_terms
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal B : Type} [inst : DecidableEq Iri] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Literal] [inst_2 : DecidableEq B]
  (G : List (RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B)) (q : RDF11.Term Iri Literal B),
  q ∈ RDF11.InstanceSearch.terms G ↔ ∃ t, t ∈ G ∧ (q = t.subject ∨ q = t.predicate ∨ q = t.object)

declarations.name: RDF11.InstanceSearch.mem_terms._simp_1_2
declarations.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {f : α → List β} {b : β} {l : List α}, (b ∈ List.flatMap f l) = ∃ a, a ∈ l ∧ b ∈ f a

declarations.name: RDF11.InstanceSearch.negative_countermodel
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal B : Type} [inst : DecidableEq Iri] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Literal] [inst_2 : DecidableEq B]
  (G E : List (RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B)),
  RDF11.InstanceSearch.check G E = false →
    (RDF11.Herbrand.interpretation (RDF11.Set.ofList G)).Satisfies (RDF11.Set.ofList G) ∧
      ¬(RDF11.Herbrand.interpretation (RDF11.Set.ofList G)).Satisfies (RDF11.Set.ofList E)

declarations.name: RDF11.InstanceSearch.negative_not_entails
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal B : Type} [inst : DecidableEq Iri] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Literal] [inst_2 : DecidableEq B]
  (G E : List (RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B)),
  RDF11.InstanceSearch.check G E = false → ¬RDF11.SimplyEntails (RDF11.Set.ofList G) (RDF11.Set.ofList E)

declarations.type:

declarations.name: RDF11.InstanceSearch.ordinaryCheck.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal B : Type} [inst : DecidableEq Iri] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Literal] [inst_2 : DecidableEq B]
  (G : List (RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B)) (E : List (RDF11.Triple Iri Literal B)),
  RDF11.InstanceSearch.ordinaryCheck G E = RDF11.InstanceSearch.check G (List.map RDF11.Triple.generalize E)

declarations.name: RDF11.InstanceSearch.ordinaryCheck_iff
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal B : Type} [inst : DecidableEq Iri] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Literal] [inst_2 : DecidableEq B]
  (G : List (RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B)) (E : List (RDF11.Triple Iri Literal B)),
  RDF11.InstanceSearch.ordinaryCheck G E = true ↔
    RDF11.SimplyEntails (RDF11.Set.ofList G) (RDF11.Graph.generalize (RDF11.Set.ofList E))

declarations.name: RDF11.InstanceSearch.ordinaryDecision
declarations.type:
{Iri Literal B : Type} →
  [DecidableEq Iri] →
    [DecidableEq Literal] →
      [DecidableEq B] →
        (G : List (RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B)) →
          (E : List (RDF11.Triple Iri Literal B)) →
            Decidable (RDF11.SimplyEntails (RDF11.Set.ofList G) (RDF11.Graph.generalize (RDF11.Set.ofList E)))

declarations.name: RDF11.InstanceSearch.ordinary_interpolation_apart
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal B₁ B₂ : Type} (G : RDF11.GeneralizedGraph Iri Literal B₁) (E : RDF11.Graph Iri Literal B₂),
  RDF11.SimplyEntails G E.generalize ↔
    ∃ μ,
      RDF11.Set.subset (RDF11.GeneralizedGraph.substitute μ (RDF11.GeneralizedGraph.mapBlank Sum.inr E.generalize))
        (RDF11.GeneralizedGraph.mapBlank Sum.inl G)

declarations.name: RDF11.InstanceSearch.ordinary_mapBlank_list
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal B₁ B₂ : Type} (E : List (RDF11.Triple Iri Literal B₁)) (f : B₁ → B₂),
  RDF11.Set.ofList (List.map (RDF11.Triple.mapBlank f) E) = RDF11.Graph.mapBlank f (RDF11.Set.ofList E)

declarations.name: RDF11.InstanceSearch.resolve_update
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal B : Type} [inst : DecidableEq B] (μ : RDF11.Substitution Iri Literal B) (b c : B)
  (q : RDF11.Term Iri Literal B), (RDF11.InstanceSearch.update μ b q).resolve c = if c = b then q else μ.resolve c

declarations.name: RDF11.InstanceSearch.satisfies_left
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal B₁ B₂ : Type} {U : Type u} (I : RDF11.SimpleInterpretation Iri Literal U)
  (G : RDF11.GeneralizedGraph Iri Literal B₁), I.Satisfies (RDF11.GeneralizedGraph.mapBlank Sum.inl G) ↔ I.Satisfies G

declarations.name: RDF11.InstanceSearch.satisfies_right
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal B₁ B₂ : Type} {U : Type u} (I : RDF11.SimpleInterpretation Iri Literal U)
  (E : RDF11.GeneralizedGraph Iri Literal B₂), I.Satisfies (RDF11.GeneralizedGraph.mapBlank Sum.inr E) ↔ I.Satisfies E

declarations.name: RDF11.InstanceSearch.search
declarations.type:
{Iri Literal B : Type} →
  [DecidableEq Iri] →
    [DecidableEq Literal] →
      [DecidableEq B] →
        List (RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B) →
          List (RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B) → Option (RDF11.Substitution Iri Literal B)

declarations.name: RDF11.InstanceSearch.search.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal B : Type} [inst : DecidableEq Iri] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Literal] [inst_2 : DecidableEq B]
  (G E : List (RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B)),
  RDF11.InstanceSearch.search G E = List.find? (RDF11.InstanceSearch.accepts G E) (RDF11.InstanceSearch.candidates G E)

declarations.name: RDF11.InstanceSearch.search_sound
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal B : Type} [inst : DecidableEq Iri] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Literal] [inst_2 : DecidableEq B]
  (G E : List (RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B)) (μ : RDF11.Substitution Iri Literal B),
  RDF11.InstanceSearch.search G E = some μ →
    RDF11.Set.subset (RDF11.GeneralizedGraph.substitute μ (RDF11.Set.ofList E)) (RDF11.Set.ofList G)

declarations.name: RDF11.InstanceSearch.singleton_list
declarations.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} (t : α), RDF11.Set.ofList [t] = RDF11.Set.singleton t

declarations.name: RDF11.InstanceSearch.term_substitute_agrees
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal B : Type} (q : RDF11.Term Iri Literal B) (μ ν : RDF11.Substitution Iri Literal B),
  (∀ (b : B), RDF11.Term.hasBlank b q → μ.resolve b = ν.resolve b) →
    RDF11.Term.substitute μ q = RDF11.Term.substitute ν q

declarations.name: RDF11.InstanceSearch.term_substitute_of_blank
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal B : Type} (q : RDF11.Term Iri Literal B) (μ : RDF11.Substitution Iri Literal B) (b : B),
  RDF11.Term.hasBlank b q → RDF11.Term.substitute μ q = μ.resolve b

declarations.name: RDF11.InstanceSearch.terms
declarations.type:
{Iri Literal B : Type} →
  [DecidableEq Iri] →
    [DecidableEq Literal] →
      [DecidableEq B] → List (RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B) → List (RDF11.Term Iri Literal B)

declarations.name: RDF11.InstanceSearch.terms.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal B : Type} [inst : DecidableEq Iri] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Literal] [inst_2 : DecidableEq B]
  (G : List (RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B)),
  RDF11.InstanceSearch.terms G = RDF11.Enumeration.unique (List.flatMap (fun t => [t.subject, t.predicate, t.object]) G)

declarations.name: RDF11.InstanceSearch.triple_substitute_agrees
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal B : Type} (t : RDF11.GeneralizedTriple Iri Literal B) (μ ν : RDF11.Substitution Iri Literal B),
  (∀ (b : B), RDF11.GeneralizedTriple.hasBlank b t → μ.resolve b = ν.resolve b) →
    RDF11.GeneralizedTriple.substitute μ t = RDF11.GeneralizedTriple.substitute ν t

declarations.name: RDF11.InstanceSearch.update
declarations.type:
{Iri Literal B : Type} →
  [DecidableEq B] → RDF11.Substitution Iri Literal B → B → RDF11.Term Iri Literal B → RDF11.Substitution Iri Literal B

declarations.name: RDF11.InstanceSearch.update.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ {Iri Literal B : Type} [inst : DecidableEq B] (μ : RDF11.Substitution Iri Literal B) (b : B)
  (q : RDF11.Term Iri Literal B) (c : B), RDF11.InstanceSearch.update μ b q c = if c = b then some q else μ c
